elements.element: Customer owns Deliverables and work product created for Customer.
elements.evidence: The clause states that the Company owns all deliverables and work product created for it under the Agreement.

elements.element: Vendor assigns the Deliverables and work product to Customer.
elements.evidence: HDI expressly “hereby assigns all such deliverables and work product” to the Company.

elements.element: Vendor retains its pre-existing intellectual property.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly states that HDI retains its pre-existing intellectual property.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Vendor IP embedded in Deliverables is perpetual.
elements.evidence: The licence to HDI intellectual property embedded in the deliverables is expressly perpetual.

elements.element: Customer's licence to embedded Vendor IP is irrevocable.
elements.evidence: The licence to embedded HDI intellectual property is expressly irrevocable.

elements.element: Customer's licence to embedded Vendor IP is royalty-free.
elements.evidence: The licence to embedded HDI intellectual property is expressly royalty-free.

elements.element: Customer retains all rights in Customer Data.
elements.evidence: The Company expressly retains all rights in customer, order, user and other data belonging to, supplied by or processed for it.

elements.element: Any Vendor licence in Customer Data is limited to processing it solely to provide the Services.
elements.evidence: Any licence of such data to HDI is expressly limited to processing it solely to provide the Services.

elements.element: The parties do not jointly own intellectual property.
elements.evidence: The clause states that no intellectual property shall be jointly owned by the Parties.

elements.element: Vendor may retain ownership of generic tools and know-how.
elements.evidence: HDI retains only its pre-existing intellectual property; generic tools and know-how, including any developed during performance, are not expressly reserved.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is perpetual.
elements.evidence: No licence to the Deliverables is granted; the Company instead owns them, while the perpetual licence applies only to embedded HDI intellectual property.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is irrevocable.
elements.evidence: No licence to the Deliverables is granted; irrevocability is stated only for the licence to embedded HDI intellectual property.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is worldwide.
elements.evidence: The clause does not expressly provide a worldwide licence to the Deliverables or to embedded HDI intellectual property.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is royalty-free.
elements.evidence: No licence to the Deliverables is granted; royalty-free status is stated only for the licence to embedded HDI intellectual property.

elements.element: Customer may use and modify Deliverables for its business.
elements.evidence: Although the Company owns the Deliverables, the embedded-HDI-IP licence does not expressly grant modification rights or specify business-use rights.

elements.element: Customer may sublicense Deliverables for its business.
elements.evidence: No sublicensing right is stated, particularly for HDI intellectual property embedded in the Deliverables.

elements.element: Any Vendor licence in Customer Data is limited to processing it solely to provide the Services.
elements.evidence: Any licence of Company data to HDI is expressly limited to processing it solely to provide the Services.
